articles.title: Stagwell Acquires Publisher Monetization Network Freestar
articles.summary: Agency holding company Stagwell is acquiring publisher monetization network Freestar, it announced Monday. The deal is the latest sign that media buyers are moving closer to publishers to shorten supply paths and get at ...

articles.title: Stagwell buys Freestar, putting publisher ad sales inside a holdco
articles.summary: Publishers have long wished agencies would put their money where their panel talking points are. Stagwell has done something adjacent.

articles.title: Anthropic’s IPO filing reveals its strategy for keeping enterprise customers hooked
articles.summary: Anthropic’s S-1 shows more than half of its $100,000-plus customers now use both the Claude Platform and a first-party app, a cross-selling playbook reminiscent of Amazon that’s making enterprise customers stickier.
